contract.precondition: self.CurrentCashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false and self.CurrentCashDesk.IsOpened = true and (self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = true or self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = true)
contract.postcondition: let desk : CashDesk = self.CurrentCashDesk, newSale : Sale = self.CurrentSale in result = true and newSale.oclIsNew() = true and newSale.IsComplete = false and newSale.IsReadytoPay = false and newSale.BelongedCashDesk = desk and desk.ContainedSales->includes(newSale)
